title: NJ’s former Lt Gov is using AI to say he’s innocent of sexual harassment
key_facts: New Jersey Lt. Gov. Dale Caldwell resigned on 25 Sep 2026 after an investigation found he sexually harassed a staffer and repeatedly violated ethics rules.
In an NJ PBS interview he said he ran the report through multiple AI platforms.
He said no AI gave a finding of sexual harassment in 59 tries.
The Verge notes chatbots are often sycophantic and tell users what they want to hear.
quote_evidence: "I put it through AI," he said, "and it said 59 times..."
AI chatbots are notoriously sycophantic and often tell users what they want to hear.
why_it_matters_hint: An official cites chatbot output as evidence of innocence, which chatbots cannot provide.
event_date: Resignation 25 Sep 2026; interview about early Oct 2026
notes: Short article; Caldwell's claims are his own.
